figures.motivation: The practical decision joins correctness and generated length. This is an explanatory diagram, not a new experiment.
figures.workflow: Reporting pipeline. The document build reads historical outputs and grades; it performs no new model generation.
figures.lora: Conceptual LoRA pipeline. Training and the later thinking policy are separate choices.
figures.training: The historical LoRA-2 funnel retains 157 examples from a 280-problem pool. It is separate from LoRA-1 and the full-set combinations.
figures.weighting: Illustrative arithmetic showing equal problem weighting. These two example problems are not observations from the benchmark.
figures.bootstrap: The saved uncertainty procedure resamples problems while retaining each paired comparison. Intervals are unadjusted.
figures.decision: Suggested follow-up workflow. It is a recommendation, not an additional completed evaluation.
figures.controls: ON, OFF, and limits differ in how explicit notes precede the answer. LoRA can be combined with these policies; widths are schematic.
figures.dataset: The main test collection has 164 HumanEval+, 166 LiveCodeBench easy, and 134 LiveCodeBench medium tasks.
figures.accuracy: Accuracy uses equal problem weights over all available attempts on 464 problems per method. Selected limits are 512, 1,024, and 2,048 by size.
figures.tokens: Mean total new tokens with equal problem weighting over available attempts. Thinking budgets do not cap the complete answer.
figures.caps: Saved cap-hit rates across complete methods, using the combined problem-based summary. A cap hit is not a detected loop.
figures.groups0.8b: 0.8B benchmark breakdown, using all-attempt equal-problem accuracy. Group sizes are 164, 166, and 134. No hard contest tasks are included.
figures.groups2b: 2B benchmark breakdown, using all-attempt equal-problem accuracy. Group sizes are 164, 166, and 134. No hard contest tasks are included.
figures.groups4b: 4B benchmark breakdown, using all-attempt equal-problem accuracy. Group sizes are 164, 166, and 134. No hard contest tasks are included.
figures.forest: Paired first-attempt accuracy differences for each trained policy against the same policy without LoRA. Bars are unadjusted 95% intervals; crossing zero indicates an inconclusive gain.
figures.tradeoff: Each size has six points: 1 ON, 2 OFF, 3 selected limit, 4 LoRA alone, 5 LoRA + OFF, 6 LoRA + limit. All-attempt equal-problem summaries; overlapping points are retained. Lower tokens and higher accuracy are preferred.
figures.loops: Original 234-problem study with 468 attempts per method. Cap percentages use all attempts; loop percentages use capped attempts only. These are different denominators.
figures.coverage: Coverage is a denominator, not a performance score. Partial sweeps cannot establish a result on unmeasured problems.
figures.conference_accuracy: All-attempt accuracy on 464 problems. The selected free policy is OFF for 0.8B and a limit for 2B and 4B. The trained policy uses each size's selected limit.
figures.conference_forest: Matched first-attempt limit comparisons on 464 problems. Bars are unadjusted 95% paired intervals; the 2B and 4B intervals cross zero.
